summary: Graph mission authors can explicitly lower worker DAGs, text inputs, resource products and supported gates into native Effect programs. Compilation refuses unsupported constructs with a typed error naming the step and construct.

replay.detail: No stored graph or journal migration. Original step ids are retained; matching ids alone do not authorize cross-engine evidence adoption.

schema.detail: No daemon or client schema change.

compatibility.detail: Lowering is opt-in through Fractal.lower and the existing native bundle publisher. It requires explicit seat-turn mission bindings and only supports local-host exec gates. Existing published graph missions are unchanged.

manual.detail: No mandatory manual step. Authors opting in must export the lowered definition and republish normally.

recovery.detail: Existing mission publication and run recovery procedures apply.
